topics.purpose: Define machine-readable compatibility classes and checks between schema versions so additive, restrictive and breaking changes are distinguished explicitly.

semantics.relation_rule: Relation/FK/cardinality changes participate in compatibility analysis.
semantics.identity_rule: Breaking semantic identity change requires a new identity when additive evolution cannot preserve meaning.
semantics.default_rule: Missing compatibility metadata never defaults to compatible.
semantics.consumer_rule: Compatibility is evaluated against exact consumer/profile requirements.
semantics.order_rule: Version string ordering alone does not prove compatibility.
semantics.validation_rule: Compatibility result is derived evidence tied to exact source/target schema versions.

invariants.rule: Schema evolution is an explicit versioned migration between exact schema identities/versions with validated compatibility and data transformation provenance; runtime/file order never silently changes active data meaning.

hard_gates.condition: breaking semantic change kept under same identity without explicit policy

references.purpose: Migration planning uses explicit compatibility evidence.
